top_defects: higher_than/lower_than matched-evidence is DEGRADED vs ratio_between/ratio_near: it omits value_b, ratio, metric_b and relation (collapses to a single signed {value}). Seen in Q2 and Q8 (the outflow case) -- caller cannot verify the ratio/band or the by-magnitude handling from the row.

When higher_than DOES emit a ratio against a negative (outflow) metric_b (Q3 FCF vs dividends_paid), it is a raw SIGNED nonsense value (ratio:-99.26) rather than a magnitude-normalized positive -- inconsistent with ratio_near (Q5), which correctly returns a positive ratio despite negative capex.

Mitigating: the underlying FILTER for outflow relations is magnitude-correct (verified by complementary diagnostic: reverse relation returns exactly the high-payout names). The bug is in the EVIDENCE surface, not the screen logic. Input params were OBVIOUS for all 10 (relation form well-documented in schema); no unknown-param, no guessing.
